The problem is that Democrats only want to meet to repeat their demands that we include FREE healthcare to illegal aliens, half a billion dollars to prop up liberal news outlets, other leftist priorities, and a MASSIVE $1.5 TRILLION spending HIKE in a simple 7-week funding bill. They are holding government funding hostage.

Meanwhile, House Republicans are doing our job and restoring regular order to the appropriations process. 

If Democrats fail to pass our clean, nonpartisan, 24-page CR to keep the government open the American People will know where the blame lies.

If Democrats truly cared about protecting health care for AMERICANS, they would have supported Republicans’ Working Families Tax Cut - that STRENGTHENS Medicaid for AMERICANS who NEED and DESERVE it.

Our bill removed illegal aliens and able-bodied young men from the rolls - eliminating waste, fraud, and abuse (including removal of 2.3 million improper enrollments so far), and saving taxpayers $185 BILLION.

Now Democrats want to shut down the AMERICAN government — to give AMERICAN taxpayer-funded healthcare to NON-AMERICANS.

Congressional Democrats and the Mainstream Media are saying that Chuck Schumer’s $1.5 Trillion Dirty CR Counteroffer does not allow illegal aliens to get free healthcare. 

But IT DOES. Here’s how:

The Democrat CR would repeal our Working Families Tax Cut policies that eliminated waste, fraud, and abuse from Medicaid—including all our protections against taxpayer-funded health care benefits going to illegals.

Democrats are now trying to run away from their RIDICULOUS $1.5 Trillion big government spending bill — now that Americans are learning what’s in it.

Some Democrats now claim they don’t want illegal immigrants on Medicaid — but their previous votes, and the ACTUAL LANGUAGE of their current bill, say otherwise.

Here’s the simple reason the government is shut down:

1️⃣ House Republicans passed a CLEAN CR over 2 weeks ago to keep the government open and continue our work for the AMERICAN PEOPLE.

2️⃣ Senate Democrats blocked it to give illegal aliens free healthcare and protect themselves from their radical base.

That’s it.

Elizabeth Warren is as trustworthy on illegal aliens receiving Medicaid as she is on her own genealogy report. 

Page 57, Section 2141 of the Democrat funding bill: repeal Republican reforms and restore $200 BILLION in benefits for illegal aliens PAID FOR by the American people. 

READ IT HERE: https://t.co/kGyvQEmeqb

Republicans have been working very hard to fix the broken systems in Washington. But Chuck Schumer and the old guard prefer the old ways. 

Democrats picked the wrong fight at the wrong time for the wrong reasons. Demanding $1.5 Trillion and free healthcare for illegal aliens—just to keep the government open—is absurd. (And they know it.)

We pray a few more Senate Democrats will change course and vote with us this week to end the charade and serve the AMERICAN PEOPLE.

House Republicans are in our districts HELPING FAMILIES through this crisis that DEMOCRATS created.

Health services halted. Nutrition aid for moms and infants cut off. FEMA unable to issue flood insurance during hurricane season. And now Democrats are reportedly WAITING until after their RADICAL HATE AMERICA rally on October 18 to reopen the government.

It’s disgraceful.

Here are some simple facts:

1️⃣ Obamacare was created and passed entirely by DEMOCRATS.

2️⃣ Since Obamacare took effect, health insurance premiums have SKYROCKETED.

3️⃣ The Obamacare COVID-era subsidies were also passed entirely by DEMOCRATS, and set to expire at the end of this year.

DEMOCRATS have increased health care costs exponentially, and are now shutting down the government—as they try to cover up THEIR OWN FAILURES and somehow blame Republicans.
 
It’s time for DEMOCRATS to reopen government so we can fix this mess!

The SPLIT SCREEN couldn’t be clearer.

➡️ On one side — Republicans: Delivering REAL, POSITIVE RESULTS for the American people. We’ve passed the Working Families Tax Cut, strengthened Medicaid, lowered premiums, cut waste, reduced crime, secured the border, and restored American energy dominance and peace through strength.

➡️ On the other — Democrats: pointless TikToks, rallies with American-hating communists, assaults on law enforcement, and a GOVERNMENT SHUTDOWN to appease the radical Left.

The American people SEE THE DIFFERENCE.

Democrats are NOT “fighting for health care.”

They CREATED the (UN)Affordable Care Act — which has made costs SKYROCKET.  Now, they want to subsidize insurance companies with even MORE taxpayer money to hide their policy failures.

Republicans are actually making health care more affordable — ending waste, fraud, and abuse, protecting care for seniors, the disabled, and pregnant women, and saving taxpayers BILLIONS.

If the media were honest, that would be in every story they write.

The so-called “Affordable Care Act” delivered exactly the opposite.
 
Democrats broke our healthcare system, Democrats crafted the bill that drove premiums through the roof, and Democrats created a COVID-era subsidy they themselves set to expire on December 31 – because they knew it was a boondoggle.
 
Democrats handed a ticking time bomb to the American people and it is REPUBLICANS who have ideas to bring healthcare costs down, restore sanity, and fix the Democrats’ mess.

Last November, the American people gave Republicans a clear mandate to clean up the mess Joe Biden and the Democrats created — and we’ve delivered:

• Permanent Trump tax cuts
• A sealed border
• Medicaid reforms saving $185B
• Stronger SNAP work rules
• No tax on tips or overtime
• 67 America First EOs codified
• 23 Biden-era regulations repealed
• Regular order appropriations restored
• Major bills on fentanyl, crime, crypto, energy & more

And we’re not slowing down!

Let’s be clear: Democrats’ “affordability” agenda is nothing more than wanting to give MASSIVE handouts to big insurance companies.

They broke the health care system and now want taxpayers to subsidize it indefinitely — with NO reforms, NO accountability, and subsidies that even go to households making hundreds of thousands a year.

This doesn’t lower costs. It hides the cost of their FAILED law.

Today House Republicans introduced the Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act. 

While Democrats demand that taxpayers write bigger checks to insurance companies to hide the cost of their failed law, House Republicans are tackling the real drivers of health care costs to provide affordable care, increase access and choice, and restore integrity to our nation’s health care system for all Americans.

Read my full statement here:

https://t.co/PnB9iXwMNe

A new report just revealed the STAGGERING fraud taking place in the Unaffordable Care Act last year alone:

• Huge amounts paid to insurance companies for countless thousands of people WHO DON’T EXIST

• $94 million sent to insurers for the DECEASED

• 68,000 Social Security numbers used by multiple people to cheat the system

Republicans are the only ones with real solutions to bring costs down — while Democrats just want to pour BILLIONS more taxpayer dollars into big health insurance companies that will only keep your costs HIGH and quality of care LOW.

Read the full article here ⬇️
https://t.co/3Ycs5KiKr1

15 years ago, Democrats broke our health care system — and their solution today is to simply throw BILLIONS more taxpayer dollars to big health insurance companies to hide the cost of their failures.

Republicans are delivering lower costs with the Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act — by addressing many of the ROOT CAUSES of rising premiums under Democrat policies.

Lower costs. More choice. Better care. That’s what our bill delivers.

And instead of fixing the damage THEY CAUSED, Democrats just want to keep extending COVID-era handouts to big health insurance companies with NO guardrails against fraud.
  
That does not lower costs.  It HIDES the cost AND makes coverage even MORE expensive. 
 
Democrats insist upon rewarding failure — but Republicans will not allow it.

This is a disgrace.

A top federal prosecutor says the amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could be OVER $9 BILLION in stolen taxpayer funds.

When are we going to see firings and resignations?
